name: Pyrene
first-pass_context: Primary abstract (PMID 40761015) describes a computational CTD/GEO network of 25 endocrine-disrupting chemicals and five ESCC-associated genes. The abstract names benzo[a]pyrene; that is a different molecule from pyrene (DTXSID3024289). No pyrene administration or BUB1B intervention is established.
track2_disposition: Name-fragment/chemical-identity mismatch plus computational association; no pyrene efficacy, BUB1B restoration or MVA benefit. No candidate promotion.
review_state: Primary abstract checked; benzo[a]pyrene is not pyrene; full article unavailable in this pass.

name: Cocaine
first-pass_context: The primary abstract lists the KEGG “cocaine addiction” pathway in an MCAO transcriptome analysis; it does not report cocaine treatment.
track2_disposition: Pathway-label lexical collision, not a cocaine efficacy result; no candidate promotion.

name: Ozone
first-pass_context: Primary neonatal-mouse study exposed 3-day-old BALB/c pups to 1,000 ppb ozone for 3 h; whole-lung microarray (n=4/group/time) and its supplementary table report the Bub1b probe 2.16-fold lower at 24 h (P=6.90e-5, q=0.043). Independent GEO-matrix reanalysis reproduces the direction and values to rounding; no significant Bub1b change at 6 h.
track2_disposition: Adverse-direction environmental-exposure comparator, not a BUB1B-restoration lead. BUBR1 protein/function, chromosome fidelity, muscle and MVA were not measured; do not transfer this inhalation result to ambient exposures or distinct medical-ozone routes.
review_state: Primary article, supplement, GEO matrix and GPL7202 annotation checked; independent per-probe reanalysis reproduced the published Bub1b row.

name: Palladium
first-pass_context: Matched title concerns palladium-catalyzed synthesis of an HDAC6-inhibitor dimer; palladium is a synthesis-catalyst context.
track2_disposition: Not a BUB1B treatment in the matched source; no candidate promotion.

name: Interferon-gamma
first-pass_context: Full open primary article (PMID 39273214): interferon-gamma was administered to NF1-associated MPNST cells and xenografts; reported effects involved IFITM1 induction and lower Ras/ERK signaling/tumor growth. BUB1B appears in background literature on MPNST genes, not as a measured response or treatment target in this study.
track2_disposition: Real antitumor intervention in a distinct NF1-MPNST model, but no BUB1B/BUBR1 or MVA muscle result; it does not support a BUB1B-restoration candidate.
review_state: Full primary PMC article checked; IFITM1/Ras-ERK mechanism, no BUB1B intervention.

name: Ethidium bromide
first-pass_context: Full primary article (PMID 27729798): ethidium bromide was used with acridine orange to stain A549 cells in an atracurium cell-death assay; it was not a candidate agent administered to test BUB1B.
track2_disposition: Assay-reagent co-mention, not an efficacy result for ethidium bromide; no BUB1B/MVA candidate promotion.
review_state: Full primary article abstract and assay role checked.
